intent: Two Claude sessions sharing one phone must not disturb each other: a keyboard open on the real screen must never make android_ui press BACK on another session's virtual display.
scope: Non-goal: no change to real-screen (display 0 / no display) behaviour, which still checks and dismisses the IME
changes: keyboard_is_up returns False when the driver targets a virtual display (display not None and not 0), so dismiss_keyboard sends no ESCAPE/BACK there
Test: a VD driver with the phone-wide keyboard shown runs no adb command at all

verification.evidence: every IME binding reads imeDisplayId=0, including one whose targetWin was com.kuhy.workout_app.sandbox on targetDisplayId=13: the IME is drawn on display 0 for VD windows

verification.command: python -m python_pkg.android_ui --display self tap ... (before the fix, while another session typed on the real screen)
verification.evidence: 'the soft keyboard is still covering the screen after ESCAPE and BACK'; the BACK popped the workout route, a second run closed the app on the VD
tapped 'Dumbbell Lunge progression settings' / 'Warmup set' / 'Wins needed down' on the VD with the other session still active

risks: A future Android build that draws the IME on the VD itself would make taps under it land on keys; the phone would have to show imeDisplayId=<vd> for that, which it does not today
rollback: After rollback, VD taps work again only while no other session has a keyboard open on the real screen
